digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation confirmations and documentation generation
propositions: Structural test assertions on the shared confirmation reduce path (emit/emit_text seam) must verify that each verb routes exactly one line through the seam and produces no stdout outside it, catching regressions that bypass the shared seam

Verb inventory table (no-op-capable vs always-writes classification) must be curated in the generator and rendered as durable documentation with a CI drift gate that fails when a verb is added without classification

Old→new confirmation-line mapping table must be recorded as golden data in generated documentation, capturing pre-merge and post-merge output for all verbs including the transition UNBLOCKED→silence behavior change

The verb inventory and mapping tables must be generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py and rendered into docs/cli-reference.md (not hand-edited), with drift gating via _check_mutation_verbs() and test enforcement
